_note: Career catalogue for recommendations. 'abilities' are weights (1-3) for the Dishaa Quest abilities; 'interests' match the questionnaire. Pathways are general guidance; check details with a counsellor and official exam sites. 'missionId' links to a career simulation and its colleges.

careers.name: Software Engineer
careers.summary: Builds the apps, websites and systems people use every day.

careers.name: Data Scientist
careers.summary: Finds patterns in data to help companies and governments decide.
careers.stream: Science with Maths, or Commerce with Maths
degrees: B.Tech, or B.Sc in Statistics / Maths / Data Science

careers.name: UX Designer
careers.summary: Designs apps and products that are easy and pleasant to use.

careers.name: Architect
careers.summary: Designs homes, schools and buildings that people live and work in.
careers.stream: Science with Maths (PCM is required for B.Arch)

careers.name: Urban Planner
careers.summary: Plans roads, transport and neighbourhoods so cities work for everyone.

careers.name: Forensic Accountant
careers.summary: Follows the money to uncover fraud for companies and investigators.

careers.name: Chartered Accountant
careers.summary: Manages accounts, audits and taxes for people and companies.
degrees: CA through ICAI, often with B.Com

careers.name: Doctor
careers.summary: Diagnoses and treats patients in hospitals and clinics.

careers.name: Psychologist
careers.summary: Helps people with their thoughts, feelings and behaviour.
degrees: BA / B.Sc Psychology, then MA / M.Sc
Clinical work needs further RCI-recognised training

careers.name: Lawyer
careers.summary: Advises clients and argues cases in court.

careers.name: Journalist
careers.summary: Investigates and reports news in print, TV and online.
degrees: BJMC / BA in Journalism or Mass Communication

careers.name: Civil Engineer
careers.summary: Builds bridges, metros, roads and buildings.

careers.name: Robotics Engineer
careers.summary: Designs machines that sense, move and work on their own.
degrees: B.Tech in Mechanical, Electronics or Robotics

careers.name: Economist
careers.summary: Studies how money, jobs and markets work, and advises on policy.

careers.name: Environmental Scientist
careers.summary: Studies pollution, climate and ecosystems, and finds ways to protect them.
degrees: B.Sc Environmental Science, or B.Sc then M.Sc

careers.name: Game Designer
careers.summary: Invents the rules, levels and stories of video games.
degrees: Or B.Sc / B.Tech with a strong portfolio

careers.name: Teacher
careers.summary: Helps students learn, grow and discover what they love.
degrees: A degree in your subject, then B.Ed
exams: TET / CTET to teach in schools

careers.name: Product Manager
careers.summary: Decides what a tech product should do and leads the team building it.
degrees: Usually engineering, design or business, often followed by an MBA
